title: The Night Garden
objectives_ko: 글자 M·N·O의 이름과 소리를 알고 말한다
M·N·O로 시작하는 단어 9개를 듣고 말하고 찾는다
사이트워드 we, like를 보고 읽는다 (1~4유닛 사이트워드 복습)

story.title: The Night Garden

panels.desc: The second garden at night under a deep blue sky with a big smiling crescent moon. A brown monkey sits in a tree holding a glowing golden seed tightly, pouting. Bun holds up a white milk carton toward the monkey; Hedgie points at the moon; Pip glows like a little lamp beside them. Hidden in the picture: the moon, the monkey, the milk carton. In the foreground, a big clay flower pot with only the tip of Grumble's striped nightcap sticking out of the top; a warm lantern glow shines from inside the pot and lights the ground around it.
panels.ko: 달이 웃고 있어요. 원숭이가 씨앗을 꼭 쥐고 있어서 번이 우유를 줘요. 큰 화분 속에 그럼블이 숨었어요.

ask.en: What is poking out of the pot?

panels.desc: A dark pond in the night garden lit by nine twinkling stars in the sky. A brown otter floats on its back tangled in a butterfly net, holding a glowing seed on its tummy. Pip, who tried to help by touching its nose like the friends do, has tumbled head-first into the same net and is stuck upside down with its feet in the air. Hedgie pulls the net handle; Bun giggles. Behind them the new M letter tree with milk-, moon- and monkey-shaped fruits. Hidden in the picture: the net, the otter, nine stars in the sky. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: 수달이 그물에 걸렸어요. 핍도 같이 걸려 거꾸로 매달렸어요! 별 아홉 개가 반짝여요.

panels.desc: The pond edge at night. A friendly purple octopus rises from the water with a glowing seed on its head and squirts a big spray of black ink: Hedgie's nose is covered with a round ink blob and he crosses his eyes to look at it; Bun ducks behind a bowl of green olives on the bank; Pip glows. Hidden in the picture: the octopus, the olives, Hedgie's ink-covered nose. Grumble's big clay flower pot has been knocked over by the splash and lies on its side: Grumble's two slippered feet and his lantern stick out of the opening, the lantern glowing a clear warm orange.
panels.ko: 문어가 잉크를 뿜어서 헤지 코가 까매졌어요. 화분이 넘어져 그럼블 슬리퍼가 삐죽!

panels.desc: The night garden path lit by nine bright stars overhead. Three new letter trees (M with milk, moon and monkey fruits; N with nose, net and nine-balloon fruits; O with otter, octopus and olive fruits) glow softly in the starlight. Bun and Hedgie dance with arms up; Pip glows brightly on top of the M tree. Grumble climbs out of the tipped-over flower pot covered in dirt, nightcap crooked, holding up his lantern which now shines clearly brighter than before and lights his grumpy, surprised face. Hidden in the picture: nine stars, the smiling moon.
panels.ko: M·N·O 나무가 별빛 아래 빛나요. 그럼블이 흙투성이로 화분에서 나왔어요. 등불이 확실히 밝아졌어요.

story.synopsis_ko: 둘째 정원은 밤이에요. 원숭이에게 우유를 주고, 그물에 걸린 수달(과 핍!)을 꺼내고, 문어가 잉크를 뿜어요. 화분에 숨은 그럼블은 데굴 굴러 나왔어요. 별 아홉 개가 길을 비춰요.
story.so_far_ko: 첫 정원 산책에서 열두 나무를 복습했어요. 그럼블의 모자 작전은 실패했어요.
story.goal_ko: 밤 정원에서 씨앗 세 개를 찾아 M·N·O 나무를 키워요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation at night: the crescent moon smiles and twinkles, the monkey hugs its glowing seed and then reaches for the milk carton, the baby bird glows softly; the lantern glow inside the big flower pot flickers. Camera still. Calm, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle comic picture-book animation: the purple octopus pops up from the pond and squirts a puff of ink that lands on the hedgehog's nose, the rabbit ducks, the big flower pot wobbles and tips over with two slippered feet poking out; the seed sparkles and with a soft POP a small letter tree sprouts by the pond. Camera still. Playful, child-friendly. No text.

Three new letter trees (M, N, O with their fruits) glow under the nine stars. Hidden in the picture: the octopus, the olives, Hedgie's inky nose.
